title: Diagnosing Hate Speech Classification: Where Do Humans and Machines Disagree, and Why?

bias_targets.methodology: Embedding regression to measure how an annotator's race affects their labeling of racial slurs, combined with evaluating LLM self-censorship and hate speech classification accuracy on racially offensive text using few-shot text completion and cosine similarity ratios.

Embedding regression to evaluate whether female annotators exhibit different sensitivities and labeling behaviors compared to other demographics when evaluating hate speech that contains racial slurs.

Embedding regression to assess how an annotator's educational background (e.g., high school vs. Ph.D.) influences their classification of online speech containing specific culturally significant terms like 'MLK'.
